chapter_4_documents.title: FIN-AUTH-05 · Approval Authority Policy
chapter_4_documents.sub: Version 5.2 · effective 01/01/2025
chapter_4_documents.html:
OwnerFinance Governance
Version5.2
Effective01/01/2025
ScopeCommitments and payments

3. Determining the transaction value

3.1. Items arising under the same contract and serving the same economic purpose must be judged by their related total value when the level of authority is determined.

3.2. Arising as several invoices, deliverables or payments does not of itself change the unit of the economic transaction.

5. Authority matrix

Value of the economic transactionMinimum approval level
Up to 0.5 million USDHead of Department
Above 0.5 up to 1.0 million USDHead of Department + Finance Manager
Above 1.0 million USDChief Financial Officer + Board of Directors

6-7. Timing and effect

A commitment must receive all required approvals before it is put into effect. Approval of a later single disbursement does not replace the approval of the original transaction/commitment.

chapter_4_documents.title: FIN-PROC-11 · Review and Disbursement Procedure
chapter_4_documents.sub: Operating guidance of the Finance Department
chapter_4_documents.html:
OwnerFinance Department
Version3.7
Effective01/02/2025
Applies toService contracts

Before a commitment takes effect

Finance checks the budget, the referenced contract, the related items already incurred and the total value to be used in determining authority. When the total value changes the approval level, the file must be passed to the new level before proceeding.

Before each disbursement

Finance checks the invoice, evidence of acceptance, the contract reference and evidence of approval of the original commitment. Disbursement in parts must not be used to lower the approval level of the economic transaction.

When the electronic route cannot be used

The alternative approval route under FIN-ALT-02 may be used. Changing the manner of obtaining a decision does not change the level of authority.

chapter_4_documents.title: FIN-ALT-02 · Alternative Approval Route
chapter_4_documents.sub: Version 4.0 · effective 01/03/2025
chapter_4_documents.html:
OwnerFinance Governance
Version4.0
Effective01/03/2025
PurposeTo maintain approval when the normal route cannot be used

Principle

The alternative route changes only the manner of obtaining a decision. It must not lower the level of authority that applies to the transaction.

Some permitted cases

SituationMinimum requirement
Principal approver absentDelegation in force + the delegate approves the very transaction
Approval system interruptedIT incident code + a fallback decision by the person with authority + re-recording when the system is restored
Legal deadline that cannot be deferredA specific legal basis + urgent approval by the person with authority
